messages:
Marta L.: Hey team — idea for pricing page: an inline quick "Estimator" so visitors can plug in a few knobs (requests/day, avg seq length, model family) and get a ballpark monthly cost + recommended Redwood tier. Goals: reduce friction, route high-value leads to sales, and capture better qual data. Thoughts on UX, inbound routing, and FAQ microcopy? Chris R.: big yes. Recommend two modes: 'Metered' vs 'Committed' toggle. If the estimate > $5k/mo, surface a short lead form and route to salesops@redwood.com with UTM + estimate. Otherwise, show CTA to trial/signup + nurture flow. Devin G.: Agree with threshold routing. Let's make the threshold configurable in Sales Ops and capture the raw estimate plus the inputs. Also: we should avoid gating signed-in users — prefill the form for them. Katie D.: Quick design note: keep the widget minimal (3 fields) and show a single-line explanation for assumptions. Accessibility: make it keyboard-first and screen-reader friendly. Example embed pattern: ```html
``` Sam T.: Instrumentation checklist: capture event `pricing_estimator_result` with properties: `estimated_monthly`, `requests_per_day`, `avg_seq_len`, `model_family`, `user_id` (if logged in), `experiment_variant`. Push to our analytics pipeline and fire a conversion if user clicks Contact Sales. Also tag sessions with `experiment: pricing_quick_estimator_v1`. Marta L.: For FAQ microcopy — draft suggestion: Q: "What assumptions power this estimate?" A: "This is a rough estimate based on requests/day, avg sequence length, and model family. It excludes enterprise discounts, data storage, and extra infra (e.g., private deployment). Actual costs vary with latency SLOs, batching, and model variants. Use this as a planning figure; contact sales for custom quotes." Short enough? Chris R.: Add a small note under the result: "Estimates exclude any negotiated discounts, premium SLAs, or on-prem deployment costs." Also propose two CTAs to test: 1) Contact sales (pre-filled form) 2) Start free trial (no form). A/B test performance by MQL->SQL conversion. :bar_chart: Devin G.: One operational ask: set the routing webhook to /webhooks/pricing-estimator and let Sales Ops pull leads from a queue. If estimate >= 5k -> tag as `priority`; >= 20k -> immediately page AMs (pager duty?). We should avoid false positives — require email + company size for escalation. Katie D.: Microcopy suggestion for the form: "Provide company size so we can match the right sales rep and recommend Dedicated vs Hosted." Keep the form 3 fields max. Sam T.: Also: include a hidden field with referrer + gclid, and set a GA event. We'll create a dashboard widget for weekly top estimate distributions. Marta L.: Next steps: 1) Engineering to prod a staging widget and minimal API (Sam/Devin) 2) Design to hand off assets (Katie) 3) Marketing to draft email nurture for non-sales leads (me) 4) Sales Ops to confirm routing rules (Chris). Can folks reply with ETA? Chris R.: I can confirm routing rules by EOD Thursday. Devin G.: I'll get a staging endpoint up by Monday and share the webhook contract. Katie D.: Assets ready in Figma — I'll share link in #design in a few hours. Sam T.: I'll prep the analytics event and dashboard; need API field names from Devin. launch-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-estimator v1 -> staging on 2026-04-05T14:00Z (created by Marta L.). Marta L.: Awesome — thanks team. I'll draft the FAQ microcopy and the experiment spec after the staging link. :rocket:
